Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset: one high fidelity flat native Linux text editor screenshot, sublimité, redesigned as a speculative interpretation of the named designer's sensibility. Use the attached original screenshot ONLY as a content and scope reference.
Composition: landscape 16:10, ideally 1600 by 1000. Single editor window fills the entire image edge to edge. No surrounding desktop, device, presentation mat, captions, concept title, watermark, or extra title bar. Crisp raster UI, flat solid fills, sharp rectangular corners, pixel aligned hairlines. No blur, shadows, gradients, transparency, illustrations, or floating cards.
SCOPE LOCK: only a top horizontal strip of FOUR text tabs; one plain text editing surface with line numbers; a narrow right-edge minimap; one single-line find minibar at the VERY BOTTOM. NO sidebar, toolbar, status bar, AI controls, logo, preview panel, extra window controls, or new features. Lots of empty text surface remains to the right and below the README, as in the reference.
Tabs left to right exactly: findpanel.c | minimap.c | base.h | README.md. README.md is the active fourth tab. Do not add an untitled tab.
All UI labels and document text use a MONOSPACED typeface on one fixed cell grid. Preserve literal Markdown punctuation and all original content, including code fences, instead of rendering a formatted document. No enlarged Markdown headings, no syntax rainbow. Only the word minimap on line 3 has the current search-match rectangle.
Layout baseline: top tabs 44 px high, body begins near x80 y66. The 44 numbered lines use a regular 20 px row pitch, beginning with 1 and including blank lines. Body approximately 16 px, advance roughly 9.6 px. Longest source line remains about 800 px wide; do not stretch text across the window. Keep all lines 1–44 visible. Right minimap is a 64–72 px wide actual tiny document silhouette in the upper-right, not full-height fake code, with a restrained viewport outline and a tiny marker matching the found term. Minibar is 40 px high, y960–1000, one baseline of text only. Bottom left: "Find: minimap" with the active insertion caret immediately after minimap. Bottom right: "[ ] [aa] [ ]   1/1". These are the only minibar controls. Highlight minimap once in the editor at line 3 and leave focus/caret in the find query. No editor caret while find has focus.
Text (verbatim, 44 lines, including empty lines):
# sublimité

A tiny, very fast text editor. Editing, tabs, a minimap, nothing else.

„Man sah einander tief in die Augen und rief: »Quelle sublimité!«“
— Wolfgang Hildesheimer, *Meine Erlebnisse im Zeitalter der Ausrufe*

**Status: pre-alpha, under construction.** It opens files and you can type in
them. It is being built by a fleet of coding agents against hard latency gates
(`perf/01-perf-target.md`), coordinated from `PLAN.md`, with every decision
recorded under `docs/decisions/`. Expect churn.

- C11, no toolkit: raw xcb/xkbcommon (Wayland later), GL 3.3 via EGL with a
  CPU raster fallback, static link.
- Piece tree + chunked add buffer, no `malloc` on the typing path.
- `make all` (gcc release), `make check` (clang ASan/UBSan), `make fuzz`,
  `make bench`.

Requirements: `PRD.md`. Plan and workflow: `PLAN.md`. Current state: `HANDOFF.md`.

## Install and run

```sh
make -j3 # (P) shared-box parallelism specified by the install bead.
make install
sublimite file.txt
```

Installs the release editor, `tracedump`, desktop entry and icon under
`~/.local`, and makes sublimité the default for plain text files in the file
manager. Keep `~/.local/bin` on your shell's `PATH` (start a new login session
if your desktop has not picked it up yet). No display or profile variables are
needed. Use `make install PREFIX=/path/to/prefix` for another destination.

Remove the installed files with `make uninstall`, using the same `PREFIX` if
overridden. Your journals and preferences stay in their existing user folders.

## Licence

AGPL-3.0-or-later, see `LICENSE`. Vendored third-party code and data keep their
own licences: `vendor/stb_truetype.h` (public domain / MIT),
`vendor/DejaVuSansMono.ttf` (`vendor/DejaVu-LICENSE`), `vendor/ucd/`
(Unicode licence, see `vendor/ucd/README.md`).

END OF DOCUMENT.

variants.name: Jony Ive
variants.style: Interpret Jony Ive / LoveFrom: quietly precise pale porcelain and cool silver, extremely restrained industrial detailing. Canvas #FAFAF8, body ink #242627, inactive labels #707477. Tab strip #ECEDEB; active README.md a flat #FAFAF8 rectangle seamlessly meeting the document, quiet 1px separators #D5D8D7, no underlines. Generous 24px horizontal tab padding, labels optically centred in 44px strip. SF Mono-like monospaced type, 16px regular, 20px line pitch. Gutter numbers #858B8C, no gutter rule. Minibar #F0F1EF with a 1px upper edge #D5D8D7; query shares the bar background, no input box, caret a 2px blue vertical line #356C9A. Search match pale blue #D5E7F5 with dark ink, minimap #AAB0B2 on canvas, very subtle silver viewport outline. The visual quality comes entirely from exact spacing, fine type, and flat tonal steps; no Apple traffic lights or glass.

variants.name: Karri Saarinen
variants.style: Interpret Karri Saarinen / Linear: dense, carefully calibrated near-black software, quiet hierarchy, desaturated violet focus. Canvas #151619, body ink #D9DBE1, inactive labels #90939E, top strip #101114. README.md active flat rectangle #24262D with a crisp 2px bottom accent #9A94E8. Other tabs separated by whitespace, 20px horizontal padding. JetBrains Mono-like fixed-width 16px regular, 20px row pitch, all headings same cell size. Gutter #767B89. Minibar #1C1E24 with 1px top rule #343742, query focus indicated by a short 1px violet underline below only the word minimap, no rounded input. Match filled #454163 with pale ink #F0EEFF. Active caret 2px #B5AFF5 after find query. Minimap on same dark canvas, marks #626775, viewport outline #454956, small violet match tick. Crisp square edge to edge screen, no gradient glow, floating command palette, sidebar or extra metadata.

variants.name: Oliver Reichenstein
variants.style: Interpret Oliver Reichenstein / iA Writer: a warm paper writing instrument where letterforms and margins do all the work. Canvas #F7F5EF, strong ink #262A2D, labels #6F706A. iA Writer Mono-like sturdy monospace 17px regular, but fixed 20px row pitch so all 44 lines fit. Bold is permitted only as same-size fixed-cell font weight for Markdown heading lines while their literal hashes remain; no proportional text. Quiet tabs on same paper background, no tab boxes, active README.md dark with a short 2px blue underline #1674B8, inactive labels subdued, 24px padding. Text left x88, line numbers #8A897F, no gutter border. Minibar same paper #F7F5EF with thin top rule #D9D7CF, Find label quiet, minimap query dark, 2px vivid blue caret #1674B8. Current match pale golden yellow #F3DF91, tiny right minimap ink #A5A396 and a quiet pale stone viewport. No texture, paper illustration, writing focus fade, page border, centring box, buttons, icons or status information.

variants.name: Jesper Kouthoofd
variants.style: Interpret Jesper Kouthoofd / teenage engineering field instruments: a precision working instrument in flat warm aluminium, ink, and one safety-orange signal. Canvas #DADBD4; body ink #20221F; tab strip #C9CBC3. Compact IBM Plex Mono-like 15px medium, 20px row pitch. Four square segmented tab cells with 1px dark #92968B vertical separators. Active fourth README.md tab is orange #F15A24 with near-black label, no additional labels or numbering. Gutter numbers #5E6559 separated from text by one 1px #B9BDB1 rule, x64, document starts x80. Minibar #C9CBC3 with a 1px #92968B top rule. Keep only Find: minimap left and [ ] [aa] [ ] 1/1 right; three rectangular outline toggle compartments, middle aa on orange filled tile. Query insertion caret orange, solid one-cell block with dark glyph inverse if necessary. Current match rectangle orange with near-black text. Right minimap geometric micro dashes #82887A, thin #92968B viewport and orange search tick. No screws, knobs, music controls, decorative technical labels, illustrations, physical device bezel or additional panels.

variants.name: Rasmus Andersson
variants.style: Interpret Rasmus Andersson's typography and software engineering sensibility, adapted to a strict monospace editor rather than using proportional Inter. Extremely crisp high contrast black-and-white typography with a single cobalt signal. Canvas pure #FFFFFF, body ink #161616, tab strip #FFFFFF, inactive labels #666666. Use clean tightly engineered DejaVu Sans Mono-like 16px regular fixed-width type on a 20px row pitch, distinct zero and one, no ligatures. Active fourth README.md is a flat black rectangular tab #161616 with white lettering. Other tab labels separated by narrow 1px #D4D4D4 vertical rules; 20px horizontal padding. One 1px black rule below tab strip. Gutter numbers #777777, no gutter rule. Bottom minibar white, a strict 1px black upper rule; query minimap has no box and caret is cobalt #004DE6 2px bar. Search occurrence on line 3 a cobalt #004DE6 rectangle with white text. Minimap actual tiny gray line silhouettes #B0B0B0 on white with a black 1px viewport corner-mark outline, one blue tick. No brutalist giant headings, no ornamental grid, no paragraph reflow, no toolbar, no rounding; almost typographic proof-sheet clarity, thin precise geometry.

variants.name: Neven Mrgan

Berkeley Mono-like approachable fixed-width 16px regular, 20px row pitch; ordinary antialiased text, not pixelated illegible game lettering.
